description: Replying to @StriveOpp| Tech Sales Training  Maximizing life by being a good steward of it 🥂 #advocateforyourself #careeradvice #fyp #stewardship
transcript: I maximize my life by being a good steward of my life, a good steward of my internal and external world. I am not one foot in, one foot out with anything. I am fully present because I'm not stuck anywhere. When I fully commit to something, it allows me to build. It allows me to be shaped. When you are one foot in, one foot out, that gives flexibility for chaos to erupt. When it comes to maximizing my life's experience, I use all the resources around me. And within using those resources, I get cool to be a life that is full.
